testcase.system-out: Scenario: Clear an active type filter while retaining the search ✔ Given the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native` ✔ And the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And searching for "Part26" displays a matching recent part ✔ And no assembly matches "Part26" ✔ When the user opens Filter and selects Assembly ✔ Then No results is displayed ✔ And the filter control indicates one active filter ✔ When the user activates the clear control beside the active filter indicator ✔ Then the Assembly filter is unchecked ✔ And the active-filter count is removed ✔ And the search field still contains "Part26" ✔ And the matching part is displayed again ✔ And the Filter panel remains open
